title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: transcript_2 comment references wrong RFC section
description: The comment on transcript_2 at edhoc.rs:414 says 'per RFC 9528 Section 3.2.' but RFC 9528 Section 3.2 describes the 'Method' parameter, not TH_2 computation. TH_2 = H(G_Y, H(message_1)) as a CBOR Sequence is defined in RFC 9528 Section 5.3.2 (responder processing of message_2) and Section 5.4.2 (initiator processing of message_3). The comment should reference Section 5.3.2.
